decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because it was opened too late. TXN-007936 (345.58 EUR, BRIGHTWATER GADGETS, card CRD-000014) posted on 2026-06-09. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 143 days later. Under time-limits a dispute must be opened within 120 days of posting, and the limit applies even when the transaction carries fraud indicators. Authorisation AUTH-008142 does point to a payment the cardholder may not have made: entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT, fraud flag set. The card has no earlier transactions at this merchant; TXN-007936 is the only one. None of this changes the result, because the time limit is applied first. The cardholder's statement contained no instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 143 days after the charge posted on 2026-06-09. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, and this limit applies even when a transaction shows signs of fraud.
